root_cause: The unit reads a text line from an InputStream; whether that stream is trusted is not decided by the regex baseline.
explanation: No ObjectInputStream/readObject pattern is present, so the SAST baseline does not label this vulnerable. Retrieval can still surface CWE-502 because the seed unit is the safe counterpart in that family. The decision is uncertain pending human review of the input source.
remediation: Keep using a data-only reader; do not add Java deserialization of untrusted bytes.
